paragraphs: Mar bar Isak, and some say Chana bar Isak: Ketubot 27b.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson digital text of Ketubot 27b writes Mari bar Isak (מרי), whereas the supplied notice has Mar (מר). Its alternative Chana bar Isak is retained.

The saved Davidson Ketubot27b scalar has Mari bar Isak (מרי) or, in the alternative, Chana bar Isak. Hyman has Mar (מר), preserved rather than normalized to Mari. Some say retains the alternative’s force. The witness is digital text, not inspected Vilna print or proof of correction history.
